exposure: Hospital-level variation in cesarean delivery rates
Hospital cesarean delivery rate for Black patients (<23.9% vs. ≥23.9%)
outcome: Rate of different cesarean delivery indications (labor dystocia, fetal concern, no labor)
finding: Black patients had significantly higher and more variable first-birth cesarean delivery rates compared to other racial/ethnic groups, even after controlling for hospital and patient characteristics.
mod_finding: Among Black patients in hospitals with higher cesarean delivery rates, there were significantly higher rates of all cesarean delivery indications, including those with a high degree of subjectivity (labor dystocia, fetal concern, no labor).
